subject: Redwood Private: commercial terms and response-time options
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Shah <rajiv.shah@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Redwood Private: initial commercial (platform fee / support tiers)

Hi Rajiv,

Thanks for the time yesterday — attached is a refreshed commercial we discussed for Evergreen Health (quote v2). Highlights:
- Dedicated VPC private deployment with 3-node licensed cluster
- Platform fee: $120k/year (option to amortize)
- Support tiers: Standard (8x5), Premium (24x7 oncall), Oncall retainer as add-on
- One-time deployment assistance: $45k (implementation SOW)

I called out two optional levers that typically move the economics: longer amortization of the platform fee, and a limited onboarding credit against the first invoice. If you can share target ARR or preferred amortization window, we can produce a revised schedule.

Attachment: redwood-vpc-cs-quote-v2.pdf (PDF, 1 page cover + pricing appendix)

Next steps: if the headline looks directionally right, we can sketch an SOW and escalate to procurement for PO/terms.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0128

From: Rajiv Shah <rajiv.shah@evergreenhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@evergreenhealth.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 15:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood Private: initial commercial (platform fee / support tiers)

Neha,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear layout. A few procurement-level clarifications from our side before we loop legal:

1) Platform fee amortization: can this be amortized over 12 months (vs. billed upfront)? If not, what flexibility do you have?
2) Discount: given this is our first private deployment with a three-year expected usage, can you consider a 25% concession on the platform fee for year one?
3) SLA: we need a 99.9% response-time SLA for critical incidents and a named oncall contact for Weekends. Is the Premium tier able to guarantee that, and what is the incremental cost?
4) Procurement checklist: I attached our standard procurement checklist — it lists PO lead times, insurance, and SOC attestations. Please confirm Redwood's information.

If we can get a revised schedule and a short note on the SLA/retainer economics I can push this into our internal approval queue.

Thanks,
Rajiv Shah
Head of Cloud Operations, Evergreen Health
rajiv.shah@evergreenhealth.com
Attachment: evergreen-procurement-checklist.xlsx

Subject: Re: Redwood Private: initial commercial (platform fee / support tiers)

Rajiv —

Thanks for the procurement checklist. Quick answers and a counter-proposal after discussing with pricing and ops:

1) Amortization: we can amortize the platform fee across invoices for up to 18 months (we typically do 12, but greater amortization is possible if we structure it into the contract).
2) Discount: we can offer a 15% concession on the platform fee for the first 12 months in exchange for a 12-month committed term and a reference agreement clause.
3) SLA / Premium: Premium includes 24x7 escalation, named oncall, and a 30-minute critical incident response target (this is our SLO for escalation start). For a contractual 99.9% uptime SLA with a guaranteed faster incident acknowledgement window, we would provide a separate oncall retainer priced at $18k/month. We can discount the first 2 months of the retainer if the deal is signed within 30 days.

If that combination sounds directionally acceptable, Ben (copied) and I can prepare an updated quote and a short SOW outline for legal.

Best,
Neha

Subject: Re: Redwood Private: initial commercial (platform fee / support tiers)

Rajiv / Neha —

Following Neha's note I reviewed the margin impact with Finance. We can sweeten the offer to help procurement move faster:

- Additional 5% platform-fee discount (total 20% year-one) conditional on a 12-month committed purchase order and a Redwood public case study after 6 months of production.
- Onboarding credit: waive one month of the oncall retainer (effectively 1 month free) and provide a 30-day implementation milestone credit of $7,500 applied to the first invoice.
- Legal: standard Redwood commercial T&Cs apply; we can accept limited procurement redlines around insurance and data residency but need to route substantive SLA or indemnity edits to Legal.

Neha, Priyom — please produce an updated quote and flag any T&Cs procurement has requested from the checklist that will need Legal attention. Rajiv — if you can send a likely PO date, I will get the discounts locked in.

Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
